components.name: TopNavigation
components.description:
Figma Top-Navigation/Mobile (12014:45167, page ❖ Top-Navigations): a 64px navigator bar (Top-Leading 44px action ·
centred Sub heading · Top-Trailing) over an optional 64px Expand-Heading (H1–H3 + one action) and a Control-Bar slot.
The OS status bar is not part of the component; leave room for it with `env(safe-area-inset-top)`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description:
Figma Heading-Text Type=Sub with Subheading / Leading (◆ Social conversation header): with either set, the bar title
becomes a left-aligned identity — a 48px `titleLeading` visual (Avatar / ChatAvatarGroup), gap 12, the title in
Body/Extra/Bold over the subtitle in Caption/Regular (Neutral/Light), gap 2.

props.name: onTitleClick
props.description: Makes the identity a button (open the profile / group info).

props.name: trailingGroup
props.description: Figma Nav-Action/Icon-Main with a trailing icon: the trailing actions share one Tertiary pill (e.g. audio + video call).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Top-Heading-Text (Type=Sub, Body/Extra/Bold), centred in the navigator bar. Shown when collapsed or when there is no large title.

props.name: largeTitle
props.description: Figma Expand-Heading (Heading/1–3) under the navigator bar.

props.name: leading
props.description: Figma Top-Leading: an action (usually Back) or a visual (e.g. an Avatar).

props.name: trailing
props.description: Figma Top-Trailing: up to two actions.

props.name: largeTitleAction
props.description: Figma Expand-Trailing: one action beside the large title.

props.name: controlBar
props.description: Figma Control-Bar slot (48px): a Search, Segmented or Tabs under the heading.

props.name: searchAction
props.type: { onClick: () => void; label?: string; icon?: IconName | ReactElement }
props.description:
For a Search control bar: while `collapsed`, the bar folds away and this Search action appears at the start of the
trailing slot (top-right); it leaves again when the bar expands. Its `onClick` usually scrolls back up and focuses
the field. Counts toward the two trailing actions, so keep at most one other. `label` defaults to the locale's
“Search”, `icon` to icon-search-medium-line (an icon name or an element).

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Scrolled state: hides the large title and shows `title` (or the large title) in the navigator bar.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stick to the top of the scroll container.

components.name: TopNavigationActionButton
components.description: Figma Nav-Action (Icon-Main Tertiary · Flat · Liquid-Glass): a 44px circle with a 24px icon.

types.TopNavigationAction: interface TopNavigationAction { icon: IconName | ReactElement; label: string; onClick?: () => void; dot?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; }
